title: Histogram
description: Equal-width adjacent bins of continuous data with frequency on the y-axis. Serves Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (one-variable-data): shape/center/spread comparisons and questions about which bin contains the median.

binStart.description: Left edge of the first bin.

binWidth.description: Common width of every bin — equal width is structural, so only one width is parameterized.

frequencies.description: Frequency per bin, left to right; determines the bar count and heights.

binEdgesAreIntegers.description: If true, renderer validates that binStart and binWidth are integers so boundary labels stay SAT-clean.

showFrequencyLabels.description: Print each frequency above its bar.

notes: Renderer guarantees: bins are contiguous (no gaps) and share binWidth — adjacent bars touch; bin boundary labels are computed as binStart + i*binWidth, never authored; an all-zero frequency list is rejected at parse time; y-axis top is snapped to a clean multiple above the maximum frequency.
